app.lema: Your jobs up to date, from your phone.

inicio.pronto: Your week, your jobs and the end-of-day report will show up here.
inicio.salirAyuda: Next time it will ask for your PIN.

sinAcceso.texto: To get in, ask the owner for an invitation and open it on this phone.
sinAcceso.baja: If you used to sign in here, this phone may have been removed or your access turned off.

invitacion.texto: When you continue, this phone gets verified and you choose your PIN. Open it only on your own phone.
invitacion.invalidaTexto: It may have been used, expired (they last 7 days) or been canceled. Ask the owner for a new one.

pin.nuevoTexto: {largo} digits. You'll use it every day to sign in on this phone.
pin.olvide: Forgot your PIN? Ask the owner for a new invitation.

equipo.enlaceTexto: Send this link by WhatsApp, text or email. It works once, for 7 days, and must be opened on their own phone.

errores.solo_dueno: Only the owner can do this.
errores.correo_ya_registrado: That email already belongs to a member.
errores.miembro_no_activo: That member's access is turned off.
errores.miembro_invalido: That change can't be made to this member.
errores.dispositivo_invalido: This phone no longer has access.
errores.pin_invalido: The PIN has {largo} digits, numbers only.
errores.pin_debil: That PIN is too easy to guess: don't repeat one number or use a run like 1234.
errores.pin_ya_fijado: This phone already has a PIN.
errores.pin_quedan: {quedan, plural, one {# try left.} other {# tries left.}}
errores.pin_bloqueado: Too many tries. Try again at {hora}.
errores.telefono_incompleto: The phone needs at least 10 digits.
errores.entrega_antes_del_inicio: Delivery can't be before the start.
errores.etapa_no_es_del_espacio: That stage doesn't belong to that space.
errores.obra_cerrada: The job was delivered: its budget doesn't change.
errores.tipo_espacio_inexistente: That space type no longer exists.
errores.falta_tipo_generales: The catalog is missing General conditions.

obraNueva.sinPms: There are no active PMs: invite one in Team before creating the job.
obraNueva.espaciosAyuda: General conditions is added automatically. Each space gets the line items of its type.
obraNueva.partidas: {n, plural, one {# line item} other {# line items}}
obraNueva.duplicada: This client already has an active job at that address. Is this a different job?

presupuesto.ayuda: The amount for each stage of each space. Every space needs at least one stage with an amount before the job can start.
presupuesto.partidas: {n, plural, one {# line item} other {# line items}}
presupuesto.completo: Budget complete: the job is ready to start.
